::: {.hidden}
Along with authoring approximately 95% of the content for Atryum, I also designed and implemented the static documentation website authoring flow.
:::

{{< include /samples/single-source/atryum/_atryum.qmd >}}

{{< include /samples/single-source/atryum/_writing.qmd >}}

## Situation

The original ask was just to produce complete documentation for Atryum within one business day, hosted on a static website.

::: {.callout}
I wanted to go beyond just content by making the authoring process easier and more efficient, as the existing framework required writers to edit a static HTML file directly just to update content.

:::

## Solution

Instead of editing giant messes of static HTML files directly, writers now create or edit `.md` files under a `md-drafts` directory, then call a `just docs` command that builds `.html` files from the Markdown using a Python script, automatically populating links to any new pages in the existing navigation:^[**{{< fa brands github >}} `validmind/atryum/website/scripts`**: [md_to_html.py](https://github.com/validbeck/atryum/blob/main/website/scripts/md_to_html.py){target="_blank"}]

```bash
docs:
	python3 website/scripts/md_to_html.py
```

::: {.column-margin}

:::{#atryum-readme}
:::

:::
